rationale: John's work on EZswap, a multi-chain NFT and gaming-focused DEX protocol, sits at the intersection of web3, DeFi, and gaming assets—domains Stanly is actively engaged in as a web3 developer. Stanly's deep technical stack (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust, Solidity) and developer-tools focus could complement EZswap's need for robust infrastructure and tooling as the protocol scales across chains.
intro_message: John, meet Stanly Sukmajaya Kwok—a web3 AI engineer with strong Solidity and full-stack capabilities who works in developer tools and could explore technical collaboration opportunities around your multi-chain NFT DEX.
